status: original production source candidate; preliminary Wine API execution accepted, actual Windows/NTFS pending

apis.layout: producer::locate(&[u8]) -> Result<Layout, Error>; Layout { digest_offset: usize, payload_rva: u32 }
apis.pure_verifier: producer::verify_pe(data: &[u8], loaded_payload: &[u8], measured_payload_rva: u32) -> Result<[u8; 32], Error>
apis.loaded_evidence_helper: producer::loaded_identity_evidence() -> Result<VerifiedProducer, Error> on Windows; copied file_sha256() and measured payload_rva() accessors

loaded.payload_source: volatile read of the actual initialized static payload in the running module, never copied from the candidate file
loaded.module_binding: GetModuleHandleExW FROM_ADDRESS proves that the payload address belongs to GetModuleHandleW(NULL), the actual main module
loaded.measurement: checked actual payload pointer minus actual main-module base; payload START RVA, not digest-slot RVA or a disk-derived address
loaded.unsealed: all-zero digest rejects before module pathname query or filesystem acquisition
loaded.pathname: GetModuleFileNameW of actual main module; exact admitted normal absolute drive spelling only; no prefix stripping, canonicalization or current_exe pathname-only substitute
loaded.candidate: one retained ReadFile with LinkPolicy::Allow on fixed local NTFS, admitted path limits, no observed reparses, retained ancestors and full file identity
loaded.check: loaded payload and measured RVA plus held/named file/ancestor identities rechecked before/after acquisition and after cryptographic verification
loaded.poison: any observed recheck/read mismatch permanently invalidates LoadedProducer; allocation/limit errors do not establish a file mutation
loaded.handles: existing read lease retains at most 64 filesystem handles and temporarily 65; module handles are borrowed, not independently opened filesystem handles

seal.layout: 32-byte marker followed by 32-byte digest D, at the unique .rceid section start
seal.canonical_digest: SHA256 of the entire candidate file with exactly the 32-byte digest slot replaced by zeros; no other bytes ignored or normalized by verifier
seal.loaded_binding: measured payload START RVA equals the strict file layout payload_rva; disk digest equals loaded D; canonical digest equals loaded D
seal.result: SHA256 of the complete sealed candidate file, including its actual digest slot

pe.alignment: power of two; file alignment no greater than section alignment; bounded aligned headers
pe.spans: monotonically nonoverlapping raw and virtual section spans, checked complete file/image bounds
pe.unsigned: certificate/security directory is rejected; signed images are outside this profile
pe.loader_writes: declared static data directories and relocation/import/TLS write targets exclude .rceid; not complete Windows loader safety or arbitrary startup-behavior validation
pe.loader_control_writes: DIR64 and IAT destination eight-byte ranges, including terminating IAT thunks, may not intersect the declared relocation or import directory; original-thunk-zero current-slot IAT lookup remains admitted
pe.relocations: ABSOLUTE type 0 or DIR64 type 10 only, bounded checked targets
pe.imports: bounded checked descriptors/thunks and destinations, including terminating thunk
pe.tls: exact 40-byte directory; bounded callbacks target executable sections; TLS index write excludes seal

limits.allocation: captured total size and chunk count admitted before fallible candidate allocation; Rust canonical digest streams the zero-slot view without a second complete file copy
limits.scope: logical byte/work/handle limits; not allocator, kernel memory or RSS proof

commands.verify: python3 tools/seal_forever_windows.py verify --input FILE --loaded-payload HEX128 --payload-rva INT

sealer.output: exclusive new offline artifact; source preserved, no in-place rewrite
sealer.failure: failed new outputs remain for inspection; no pathname unlink cleanup after error
sealer.durability: file fsync only; no parent-directory durability or Windows crash-publication proof
sealer.checksum_option: explicit --zero-checksum permits writing a zero PE checksum in the new output before canonical hashing; verifier always requires zero checksum
sealer.supplied_seal_scope: verify uses operator-supplied payload/RVA for artifact integrity only; it does not acquire actual loaded process evidence

validation.contract_tests: static source/contract consistency only; never actual loader, filesystem or cryptographic execution proof

historical_prototype.scope: 29 external prototype cases and preliminary Wine evidence only; not executed production acceptance

preliminary_wine_execution.scope: corrected production API and helper under Wine only; not actual Windows/NTFS or enabled product acceptance
preliminary_wine_execution.filtered_trace_scope: observed network calls only; denied attempts may be absent; individual Wine descendant exit is not proven

not_claimed: arbitrary signed or unsigned PE support
complete Windows loader safety or arbitrary startup behavior
private output DACL or publication durability
